issues.on_page: Other Local Receipts 1,101,444, of which 1,074,477 is in the Columbus Educational Facilities Leasing Corporation column; the Statement of Activities (p2) Other Receipts is 376,689 (= 26,967 + 349,244 non-revenue + 478 ESU), so it eliminates the 1,074,477
issues.issue: The 1,074,477 is an intra-entity payment: Special Building Fund debt service (953,672 + 120,805 + 20 = 1,074,497, p17) passed to the blended leasing corporation. The total column records it as revenue and the government-wide statement eliminates it. Under the hidden-transfer rule it should be split out (receipt part 26,967, plus an other financing line with split_from and review), not kept as revenue.

issues.on_page: Debt Service 5,825,824 (includes Leasing Corporation 1,074,477); Statement of Activities Debt Service 4,751,346 (p2)
issues.issue: The same 1,074,477 appears both as Special Building Fund debt service (paid to the leasing corp) and as the corp's own debt service. The government-wide column eliminates 1,074,478. This is a hidden transfer that should be split per the rules; as recorded, spending is overstated by about 1.07M (offset by the receipts[8] overstatement).
